objective.text: Restore the real dispatcher after an Event::fakeFor scope.

difficulty.rationale: Track restoration after a scoped fake rather than assuming it lasts for the whole test.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

files.source:
<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;

$count = 0;
Event::listen('recount', function () use (&$count) {
    $count++;
});

Event::fakeFor(function () {
    Event::dispatch('recount');
});

Event::dispatch('recount');

echo $count;

stem: One listener increments $count. What is printed?

options.rationale: The faked event does not invoke the real listener inside the scope.
